defects.description: Text 'Design system documentation' and 'Review API endpoints' appears slightly clipped or tightly fitted within the card container
Vertical spacing between the two task cards in each column could be slightly more generous for better visual breathing room
The 'New Task' button in the header is a bit small relative to the search input field next to it

top_fixes: Increase internal padding of task cards to prevent text from feeling cramped or clipped
Add slightly more gap between the two cards within each column for better rhythm
Ensure all text strings are fully visible without any potential overflow issues

manifest.prompt: Create a kanban board with three columns - To Do, In Progress, Done - each column containing two task cards with a short realistic title and a small colored tag.
